question: Which of the following bilateral agreements was signed between India and Singapore and marked the upgrade of their relationship by exchanging several MoUs in areas such as semiconductors, digital technologies and skills development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India-Singapore Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **September 2024**, during the official visit of Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** to **Singapore**, the bilateral relationship between the two nations was officially elevated to a **Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**.
 
• This upgrade marks a significant evolution from the **Strategic Partnership** that was established in **2015**, reflecting the deepening trust and widening scope of cooperation.
 
• The two countries signed and exchanged several **Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs)** focusing on critical future-oriented sectors: **Semiconductors**, **Digital Technologies**, **Skill Development**, and **Healthcare**.
 
• The **Semiconductor ecosystem partnership** is particularly noteworthy, as it aims to leverage **Singapore’s** established global role in semiconductor manufacturing to support **India’s** nascent but ambitious semiconductor industry.
 
• The agreements were exchanged in the presence of PM **Narendra Modi** and Singapore’s Prime Minister **Lawrence Wong**, emphasizing a shared vision for a stable and prosperous **Indo-Pacific** region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Economic Synergy:** **Singapore** has consistently been one of the largest sources of **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)** for **India**, with cumulative investments exceeding **$160 billion** since **2000**.
 
• **CECA (2005):** The **Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA)**, signed in **2005**, was **India’s** first-ever comprehensive trade agreement with any country, facilitating easier trade in goods, services, and investments.
 
• **Digital Connectivity:** In **February 2023**, **India** and **Singapore** launched the linkage of their real-time payment systems—**UPI** and **PayNow**—enabling faster and cheaper cross-border remittances.
 
• **Defense Cooperation:** The maritime relationship is anchored by the **SIMBEX** (Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise), which has been held annually since **1994**, making it one of **India's** longest-running naval exercises with any foreign country.
 
• **Historical Ties:** **India** was among the first countries to recognize **Singapore** as an independent nation in **1965**, and both nations will celebrate the **60th anniversary** of diplomatic relations in **2025**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable (ISMR):** This high-level mechanism, established in **2022**, played a crucial role in identifying the new pillars of the **Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**, including **Food Security**, **Green Energy**, and **Advanced Manufacturing**.
 
• **Skill Development Focus:** The **MoU on Educational Cooperation and Skill Development** aims to collaborate on vocational training and **Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET)** to enhance the employability of the Indian workforce.
 
• **Healthcare Collaboration:** The partnership in **Healthcare and Medical Research** focuses on pandemic preparedness, genomic surveillance, and digital health solutions to tackle emerging global health challenges.
 
• **Sustainability:** Both nations are working closely under the **Green Economy** framework to promote sustainable finance, **Green Hydrogen**, and carbon credit collaborations.
